{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the data
print(df.dtypes)
print(df.head())

# Check for internal QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
# First, check if any rows have non-standard formatting
print(df['revenue'].unique()[:10])  # Inspect first 10 values

df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = df[df['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0]
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {refunded_count}")

# Filter out QA orders and refunded orders
# QA orders: revenue = 999999.99
# Refunded orders: status = refunded
filtered_df = df[(df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute total revenue by channel
revenue_by_channel = filtered_df.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Output results
print(revenue_by_channel)

# Find the channel with the highest revenue
max_channel = revenue_by_channel.idxmax()
max_revenue = revenue_by_channel.max()

print(f"Channel with highest revenue: {max_channel} ({max_revenue:.2f})")"}
